name: --yeti-base
description: Set to pin the body size at one value for every viewport; overrides both --yeti-base-min and --yeti-base-max.

name: --yeti-ratio
description: Set to pin the scale ratio at one value for every viewport; overrides both --yeti-ratio-min and --yeti-ratio-max.

name: --yeti-base-min
description: Body text size at the narrow viewport.

name: --yeti-base-max
description: Body text size at the wide viewport.

name: --yeti-ratio-min
description: Scale ratio at the narrow viewport (minor third).

name: --yeti-ratio-max
description: Scale ratio at the wide viewport (perfect fourth).

name: --yeti-viewport-min
description: Viewport width at which the narrow values apply.

name: --yeti-viewport-max
description: Viewport width at which the wide values apply.

name: --yeti-space-none
description: No space; the value behind data-gap="none".

name: --yeti-space-xs
description: Hairline gap.

name: --yeti-space-sm
description: Tight gap.

name: --yeti-space-md
description: Default gap; equals the body text size.

name: --yeti-space-lg
description: Comfortable gap.

name: --yeti-space-ratio
description: How much each space stop above lg grows on the one before; xl is base × ratio, 4xl is base × ratio⁴. Keep it above --yeti-ratio-max so xl stays larger than lg.

name: --yeti-space-xl
description: Section gap; twice the body size.

name: --yeti-space-2xl
description: Page-level gap; four bodies.

name: --yeti-space-3xl
description: Hero-level gap; eight bodies.

name: --yeti-space-4xl
description: The biggest room: sixteen bodies, the gap between a page's great sections.

name: --yeti-space-xs-static
description: Non-fluid xs, for a gap that must not scale.

name: --yeti-space-sm-static
description: Non-fluid sm.

name: --yeti-space-md-static
description: Non-fluid md.

name: --yeti-space-lg-static
description: Non-fluid lg.

name: --yeti-space-xl-static
description: Non-fluid xl.

name: --yeti-space-2xl-static
description: Non-fluid 2xl.

name: --yeti-space-3xl-static
description: Non-fluid 3xl.

name: --yeti-space-4xl-static
description: Non-fluid 4xl.

name: --yeti-radius-sm
description: Small corner radius; inputs, code, badges.

name: --yeti-radius-md
description: Medium corner radius; cards, dialogs.

name: --yeti-radius-lg
description: Large corner radius; hero panels.

name: --yeti-radius-full
description: Pill or circle.

name: --yeti-width-3xs
description: The narrowest named width: two of them fit a phone, so a grid of links, badges or small pictures at data-min="3xs" is two abreast where 2xs gives one.

name: --yeti-width-2xs
description: The narrowest named width: three of them fit a reading column, which sixteen rem does not.

name: --yeti-width-xs
description: Smallest container measure; the grid's default minimum column width.

name: --yeti-width-sm
description: The sidebar's default width.

name: --yeti-width-md
description: The columns layout's default threshold.

name: --yeti-width-lg
description: A narrow page column.

name: --yeti-width-xl
description: The center layout's default maximum.

name: --yeti-width-2xl
description: A wide page column.

name: --yeti-height-sm
description: Block size at data-height="sm"; the demo's preview box is the first taker.

name: --yeti-height-md
description: Block size at data-height="md", and with no attribute.

name: --yeti-height-lg
description: Block size at data-height="lg".

name: --yeti-height-xl
description: Block size at data-height="xl".

name: --yeti-height-half
description: Block size at data-height="half": half the viewport, dynamic so it tracks the browser chrome on phones.

name: --yeti-text-xs
description: Captions and fine print.

name: --yeti-text-sm
description: Small text; h6.

name: --yeti-text-md
description: Body text; h5 in bold.

name: --yeti-text-lg
description: Lead paragraphs; h4.

name: --yeti-text-display
description: Display type, larger than any heading.

name: --yeti-leading-md
description: Body line height; about 1.5 at body size, tightening as type grows.

name: --yeti-leading-sm
description: Line height for text set below the body size, such as a code block; a ratio, so it shrinks with the type.

name: --yeti-leading-tight
description: Heading line height.

name: --yeti-measure
description: Maximum line length for prose.

name: --yeti-list-gap
description: Space between one item of a prose list and the next.

name: --yeti-heading-space-before
description: Space above a section heading (h2, h3) in flow, from what comes before it. Read by base flow and by breakout.

name: --yeti-heading-space-after
description: Space between any heading in flow and what it opens. Read by base flow and by breakout.

name: --yeti-lede-size
description: How large a lede reads.

name: --yeti-lede-measure
description: A lede's line length. Moves with --yeti-lede-size, since ch is a unit of the font.

name: --yeti-font-sans
description: Default text face. Yeti ships no web fonts; override this to use yours.

name: --yeti-font-mono
description: Code face.

name: --yeti-font-heading
description: Heading face, every level. The text face until a theme sets a second family; one token instead of six selector overrides.

name: --yeti-stretch-text
description: font-stretch of the body: the width axis of a variable font, as a keyword or a percentage.

name: --yeti-stretch-heading
description: font-stretch of the headings, set apart from the text so a theme can pair narrow text with a wide title in one family.

name: --yeti-stretch-small
description: font-stretch of small lettering: captions, small print, a nav's links, a badge. The text width unless a theme narrows it.

name: --yeti-tracking-heading
description: letter-spacing of every heading level and the billboard. Set in em so a large heading tightens more than a small one; a page may set it on one level.

name: --yeti-duration-fast
description: Quick transitions; hover and focus. Collapses to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: --yeti-duration-base
description: Standard transitions; open and close. Collapses under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: --yeti-ease
description: Default easing; fast out, gentle in.

name: --yeti-motion-iterations
description: Iteration count for animations that run forever, such as the spinner. Collapses to 1 under prefers-reduced-motion, because a component's own infinite would outrank the reset and keep running at a random phase every frame.

name: --yeti-page-duration
description: How long the crossfade between two pages takes, for a site that has turned cross-document view transitions on. Collapses to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion, which is the only thing that stills a page transition.

name: --yeti-page-ease
description: The curve that crossfade runs on. Symmetric, unlike --yeti-ease, because neither end of a page change leads.

name: --yeti-hue-primary
description: Brand hue in oklch degrees; 250 is blue. Every primary color derives from it.

name: --yeti-hue-secondary
description: Secondary hue; 300 is violet.

name: --yeti-hue-success
description: Success hue; 145 is green.

name: --yeti-hue-warning
description: Warning hue; 80 is amber.

name: --yeti-hue-alert
description: Alert hue; 25 is red.

name: --yeti-hue-neutral
description: Hue that faintly tints surfaces, text, and borders. Follows the primary hue unless set.

name: --yeti-chroma
description: Accent saturation. Lower for a calmer palette; 0.2 and above may clip on very saturated hues.

name: --yeti-color-primary
default: ladder base of the primary hue
description: The brand color: buttons, links, focus.

name: --yeti-color-primary-subtle
description: Tinted background; hover on surfaces, selection.

name: --yeti-color-primary-soft
description: Borders and dividers in the primary hue.

name: --yeti-color-primary-strong
description: Hover and active state of the primary color.

name: --yeti-color-primary-text
description: Primary-hued text on plain surfaces.

name: --yeti-on-primary
default: near-white in light, near-black in dark
description: Text placed on --yeti-color-primary.

name: --yeti-color-secondary
default: ladder base of the secondary hue
description: Secondary accent.

name: --yeti-color-secondary-subtle
description: Tinted background in the secondary hue.

name: --yeti-color-secondary-soft
description: Borders in the secondary hue.

name: --yeti-color-secondary-strong
description: Hover and active state of the secondary color.

name: --yeti-color-secondary-text
description: Secondary-hued text on plain surfaces.

name: --yeti-on-secondary
default: near-white in light, near-black in dark
description: Text placed on --yeti-color-secondary.

name: --yeti-color-success
default: ladder base of the success hue
description: Positive state.

name: --yeti-color-success-subtle
description: Tinted background for success messages.

name: --yeti-color-success-soft
description: Borders for success messages.

name: --yeti-color-success-strong
description: Hover and active state of the success color.

name: --yeti-color-success-text
description: Success-hued text on plain surfaces.

name: --yeti-on-success
default: near-white in light, near-black in dark
description: Text placed on --yeti-color-success.

name: --yeti-color-warning
default: ladder base of the warning hue
description: Caution state.

name: --yeti-color-warning-subtle
description: Tinted background for warnings.

name: --yeti-color-warning-soft
description: Borders for warnings.

name: --yeti-color-warning-strong
description: Hover and active state of the warning color.

name: --yeti-color-warning-text
description: Warning-hued text on plain surfaces.

name: --yeti-on-warning
default: near-white in light, near-black in dark
description: Text placed on --yeti-color-warning.

name: --yeti-color-alert
default: ladder base of the alert hue
description: Error and danger state.

name: --yeti-color-alert-subtle
description: Tinted background for errors.

name: --yeti-color-alert-soft
description: Borders for errors.

name: --yeti-color-alert-strong
description: Hover and active state of the alert color.

name: --yeti-color-alert-text
description: Alert-hued text on plain surfaces.

name: --yeti-on-alert
default: near-white in light, near-black in dark
description: Text placed on --yeti-color-alert.

name: --yeti-color-neutral-subtle
description: Neutral tint for badges and quiet fills.

name: --yeti-color-neutral-soft
description: Neutral fill for hover states.

name: --yeti-color-neutral
description: Neutral accent: buttons and badges with data-variant="neutral".

name: --yeti-color-neutral-strong
description: Neutral accent, one step darker: hover and pressed.

name: --yeti-color-neutral-text
description: Neutral-hued text on plain surfaces.

name: --yeti-on-neutral
default: near-white in light, near-black in dark
description: Text placed on --yeti-color-neutral.

name: --yeti-color-surface
description: Page background.

name: --yeti-color-surface-raised
description: Cards, code blocks, anything sitting on the page.

name: --yeti-color-surface-sunken
description: Wells and inset areas.

name: --yeti-color-text
description: Body text.

name: --yeti-color-text-muted
description: Secondary text: captions, help, metadata.

name: --yeti-color-border
description: Default border and divider.

name: --yeti-color-border-strong
description: Emphasised border: focused inputs, blockquote rule.

name: --yeti-color-scrim
description: A wash over content so something on top of it can be read: a caption over a picture, a veil over a form. Thinned surface, so it dims with the theme rather than tinting.

name: --yeti-color-focus
description: Focus ring color.

name: --yeti-link-color
description: Text color of a link at rest. Read with a fallback, so a section's own primary still colors its links. A theme whose primary is too light to read as text points this at the hue's text step, --yeti-color-primary-text.

name: --yeti-link-color-hover
description: Text color of a link under the pointer. Read with a fallback, so a section's own primary still colors its links.

name: --yeti-divider-line
description: The rule beside the text in a divider layout, written as a border.

name: --yeti-leaders-line
description: The line between a name and a value in a leaders layout, written as a border.

name: --yeti-cover-height
description: Minimum block size of a cover layout or a filled stack. Set to auto for one that is only as tall as its content.

name: --yeti-sticky-offset
description: How far from the leading edge of the scrollport a child carrying data-sticky stops. Set it to a sticky bar's height on whatever holds the things that stick below it.

name: --yeti-scroll-padding
description: Where a scroll-into-view stops below the top edge: a fragment jump, scrollIntoView, a focused control. The sticky offset by default; set it alone for more room above a jumped-to heading than the things that stick need. Root-level: it is read by the root's scroll padding.

name: --yeti-border-width
description: Width of every border a component draws.

name: --yeti-weight-normal
description: Body weight.

name: --yeti-weight-bold
description: th, strong, b and, through --yeti-weight-heading, the headings. Separate from --yeti-weight-strong so display text and control labels can be tuned apart.

name: --yeti-weight-heading
description: The headings' own weight, bold unless a theme sets it: a display face often wants 500 or 800 where strong text stays at 700.

name: --yeti-weight-strong
description: Labels, headers, buttons.

name: --yeti-shadow-color
default: black at 14% in light, 55% in dark
description: The color every shadow is drawn in; a theme changes offsets without losing the scheme flip.

name: --yeti-shadow-sm
description: Raised cards.

name: --yeti-shadow-md
description: Floating surfaces; phase 4's menus and dialogs.

name: --yeti-control-size
description: Minimum block size of a button or input at data-size="md".

name: --yeti-control-radius
description: Corner of inputs.

name: --yeti-control-border
description: Border of inputs at rest.

name: --yeti-control-surface
description: Background of inputs.

name: --yeti-control-chevron
description: The select's chevron image; a theme may supply its own, for example a lighter one for a dark control surface.

name: --yeti-opacity-muted
description: Opacity of a disabled or busy control.

name: --yeti-button-radius
description: Corner of buttons.

name: --yeti-button-weight
description: Weight of button text.

name: --yeti-button-padding
description: Inline padding as a multiple of the size's space step.

name: --yeti-button-padding-block
description: Block padding as a multiple of the size's space step. The control height still sets the minimum, so this shows on a wrapped label, and a theme raises it for roomier buttons.

name: --yeti-badge-radius
description: Corner of badges; full makes a pill.

name: --yeti-badge-weight
description: Weight of badge text.

name: --yeti-card-radius
description: Corner of cards.

name: --yeti-card-padding
description: Padding inside a card.

name: --yeti-card-gap
description: Space between a card's parts.

name: --yeti-card-border
description: Border of cards; transparent when raised.

name: --yeti-card-surface
description: Background of cards.

name: --yeti-field-gap
description: Space between a field's label, control, and hint.

name: --yeti-switch-track
description: Fill and border of an off switch's track. Keep it 3:1 against the page surface.

name: --yeti-switch-thumb
description: The thumb of an off switch.

name: --yeti-table-stripe
description: Fill of even rows with data-striped.

name: --yeti-table-border
description: Row and cell borders.

name: --yeti-seam-size
description: Depth of the cut; set it to fix the depth for every size.

name: --yeti-nav-padding
description: Padding of the bar and of the open panel.

name: --yeti-nav-radius
description: Corner of the links and the toggle.

name: --yeti-nav-border
description: The bar's bottom edge, and the sheet's.

name: --yeti-nav-surface
description: Background of the bar.

name: --yeti-nav-panel
description: Background of the open panel.

name: --yeti-nav-brand-weight
description: Weight of the nav's brand.

name: --yeti-nav-brand-size
description: Size of the nav's brand; 1em is the bar's own size.

name: --yeti-nav-logo-size
description: Height of a logo in the nav's brand; its width follows the image.

name: --yeti-nav-link
description: Color of a plain link in the bar; the bar's own color unless set. The current link and a hovered link keep the variant's tints, and the open panel resets it to its own text color.

name: --yeti-breadcrumbs-separator
description: The string between crumbs; a theme may prefer "›".

name: --yeti-pagination-radius
description: Corner of each page target.

name: --yeti-alert-radius
description: Corner of an alert.

name: --yeti-alert-padding
description: Padding inside an alert.

name: --yeti-alert-edge
default: four times the local border width
description: Width of an alert's start edge, at every emphasis. Read with a fallback to four times --yeti-border-width, evaluated locally, so a section with its own border width still gets four of its own; set this directly to fix the width regardless of the local border.

name: --yeti-progress-radius
description: Corner of the bar and of its value.

name: --yeti-progress-size
description: Thickness of the bar, a length. Read with a fallback to half the size's space step; a hairline reading bar sets 2px.

name: --yeti-spinner-duration
description: One turn of the ring; reduced motion stops it.

name: --yeti-spinner-width
description: Thickness of the ring.

name: --yeti-accordion-border
description: The line between one panel and the next, and around the set.

name: --yeti-accordion-padding
description: Padding of a summary and of its panel.

name: --yeti-accordion-surface
description: Background of the set, and so of an open panel.

name: --yeti-accordion-summary
description: Background of a summary row, set apart from the panel below it. Mixed toward the text color, so it darkens the row in light and lifts it in dark.

name: --yeti-accordion-summary-hover
description: Background of a summary under the pointer, one step further from the panel than at rest.

name: --yeti-tabs-border
description: The line under the tab list.

name: --yeti-tabs-padding
description: Padding of one tab.

name: --yeti-dropdown-surface
description: Background of the open panel.

name: --yeti-dropdown-radius
description: Corner of the panel.

name: --yeti-dropdown-padding
description: Padding around the items.

name: --yeti-dropdown-min
description: Least width of the panel.

name: --yeti-dropdown-open-delay
description: How long the pointer must rest on a data-trigger="hover" dropdown before its panel opens. Read by hover.js, so it has no effect without that module.

name: --yeti-dropdown-close-delay
description: How long a hover-triggered panel waits after the pointer leaves before it closes, so the gap between trigger and panel is forgiving. Read by hover.js.

name: --yeti-dialog-surface
description: Background of the dialog.

name: --yeti-dialog-radius
description: Corner of the dialog.

name: --yeti-dialog-padding
description: Padding inside the dialog.

name: --yeti-dialog-backdrop
description: The backdrop behind an open dialog. Black rather than a theme color, because a backdrop dims what is behind it in every theme.

name: --yeti-tooltip-surface
description: Background of the bubble, inverted so it reads over anything.

name: --yeti-tooltip-text
description: Text of the bubble.

name: --yeti-tooltip-radius
description: Corner of the bubble.

name: --yeti-carousel-dot
description: Color of a slide dot.

name: --yeti-carousel-dot-size
description: Diameter of a slide dot.

name: --yeti-carousel-scroll
default: smooth, and auto under reduced motion
description: How the track scrolls when a dot is followed. A components-layer declaration outranks the reset, so the preference reaches the track through this token.

name: --yeti-toc-scroll
default: smooth, and auto under reduced motion
description: How the page scrolls when a link in a toc, or an in-page link in a nav, is followed. A components-layer declaration outranks the reset, so the preference reaches the page through this token. The name keeps the toc it started with.

name: --yeti-toc-padding
description: The rows' block padding: a control's density by default, a book's contents page sets it smaller.

name: --yeti-toc-hover
description: Background of a toc link under the pointer. Read with a fallback to the variant's subtle tint; set transparent for an underline-only list.

name: --yeti-range-value
description: The filled share of a range's track. Set it on the input, inline or from your own script, since CSS cannot read the value. Not a theme value.

name: --yeti-demo-border
description: The preview box's edge.

name: --yeti-demo-radius
description: The preview box's corner, the summary's, and the stop label's.

name: --yeti-demo-label
description: Surface of the stop label naming the current width, and of the summary.

name: --yeti-enter-duration
description: How long one arrival takes. Collapses to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion, which leaves the element present and still.

name: --yeti-enter-distance
description: How far below its place a rising element starts.

name: --yeti-enter-scale
description: How small a scaling element starts.

name: --yeti-enter-stagger
description: The wait between one staggered child and the next; every child's delay is a multiple of it. Collapses to 0s under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: --yeti-enter-delay
description: How long an element waits before it arrives, or a staggered run before its first child moves. Set it on one element to time that element alone.

name: --yeti-enter-ease
description: The curve a staggered entrance runs on.

name: --yeti-lift-distance
description: How far the element rises under the pointer. Collapses to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion, so the hover keeps its deeper shadow and loses only the movement.

name: --yeti-lift-scale
description: How much the element grows at data-lift="scale"; reduced motion takes it to one.

name: --yeti-lift-shadow
description: The shadow the element casts once lifted.

name: --yeti-lift-duration
description: How long the lift takes; a consumer tinting the same hover matches it to this.

name: --yeti-lift-ease
description: The curve a lift runs on.

name: --yeti-attention-duration
description: How long the one pulse or shake takes. Collapses to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

name: --yeti-attention-distance
description: How far a shake throws the element to each side.

name: --yeti-attention-scale
description: How large a pulse swells the element at its peak.

name: --yeti-fit-width
description: The container width at which a line carrying billboard reaches the top of its pair; below it the size is in proportion, above it the clamp holds.

name: --yeti-white
description: White, in both schemes and under every theme. One of the three colors that never move.

name: --yeti-black
description: Black, in both schemes and under every theme.

name: --yeti-grey
description: 18% reflectance, the photographic middle grey, in both schemes and under every theme.

name: --yeti-grey-0
description: The page surface, as the first step of the greyscale.

name: --yeti-grey-10
description: 10% of the way from the page surface to its text. Near the page in both schemes when the number is low.

name: --yeti-grey-20
description: 20% of the way from the page surface to its text. Near the page in both schemes when the number is low.

name: --yeti-grey-30
description: 30% of the way from the page surface to its text. Near the page in both schemes when the number is low.

name: --yeti-grey-40
description: 40% of the way from the page surface to its text. Near the page in both schemes when the number is low.

name: --yeti-grey-50
description: 50% of the way from the page surface to its text. Near the text in both schemes when the number is high.

name: --yeti-grey-60
description: 60% of the way from the page surface to its text. Near the text in both schemes when the number is high.

name: --yeti-grey-70
description: 70% of the way from the page surface to its text. Near the text in both schemes when the number is high.

name: --yeti-grey-80
description: 80% of the way from the page surface to its text. Near the text in both schemes when the number is high.

name: --yeti-grey-90
description: 90% of the way from the page surface to its text. Near the text in both schemes when the number is high.

name: --yeti-grey-100
description: The page text color, as the last step of the greyscale.

name: --yeti-color-primary-0
description: The primary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-0; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-primary-10
description: The primary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-10; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-primary-20
description: The primary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-20; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-primary-30
description: The primary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-30; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-primary-40
description: The primary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-40; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-primary-50
description: The primary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-50; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-primary-60
description: The primary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-60; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-primary-70
description: The primary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-70; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-primary-80
description: The primary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-80; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-primary-90
description: The primary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-90; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-primary-100
description: The primary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-100; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-secondary-0
description: The secondary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-0; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-secondary-10
description: The secondary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-10; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-secondary-20
description: The secondary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-20; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-secondary-30
description: The secondary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-30; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-secondary-40
description: The secondary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-40; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-secondary-50
description: The secondary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-50; flips with the scheme as the grey does.

name: --yeti-color-secondary-60
description: The secondary hue at the lightness of --yeti-grey-60; flips with the scheme as the grey does.
